name: Chaos Haltière
original_name: カオス・アルティエール
source:
A minor antagonist in the 2nd main quest's episode 15 "Grimms Notes Story Zone".

Haltière is the mother of Noémie and Dorothée, and the abusive stepmother of Fam, whom she used to ruthlessly neglect and treat like garbage. She is implied to be hiding an ugly face under her mask.
